Guest Facultv (Assistant Professor) Positions at Paniab Universitv
Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) ; The Department of Economics is
conducting an interview to appoint 01 Guest Faculty member to teach B.A.
and M.A. classes for the odd Semester (July to December, 2023) in
Economics. This is an excellent opportunity for qualified individuals to
contribute to the academic growth of students and gain valuable teaching
experience.
Designation : Guest Faculty
The detail of teaching workload is as under:
Day of Teaching Classes(es) to be
taught
Subject to be taught &
working hours
Monday to Friday U.G. & P.G. As per requirement &
9.00 a.m. to 4.00 p.m.
Essential Oualification for Guest Facultv as given below:-
1. Good academic record as per latest UGC and the Panjab University
norms in Master Degree of Economics with at least 55o/o marks (50%
for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade
in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Master's
degree level from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from
an accredited foreign University.
2. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, in
the subject of Economics.
Desirable Qualification
1. Graduation with Maths/Statistics and Economics as an elective subject
or B.A.(Hons) in Economics.
Knowledge of MS Offi celS TATA/S P S S/Evi ews/R/Python.
Mathematical Economics, Statistical papers and computer software
based paper/s for economics students.

interview will be conducted from 19th to 22nd September" 2023
tentativelY.
iii) A11 applicants are advised to bring the hard copy of their form
alongwith their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification at the time of interview.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium
of Rs.15QQ/-(Rupees one thousand five hundred only) per lecture with an
upper limit of Rs.50,000/-per month as per Panjab University norrns. The
candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are
in the department as guest faculty.
No TA/DA will be Paid for the same.
